# Worked Examples and Practical Applications

## Learning objectives

By the end of this chapter, you will be able to:

- Apply the ITS workflow to a real-world research question.
- Prepare a dataset for analysis.
- Fit and interpret an ITS model.
- Conduct a controlled ITS analysis where appropriate.
- Communicate findings and limitations.

## Introduction

This chapter brings together the methods introduced throughout the guide using practical examples from public health and health policy evaluation.
